e.title: InsuranceAsia News（亚洲保险市场洞察）
e.title_hk: InsuranceAsia News（亞洲保險市場洞察）
e.summary: 按市场切分的亚洲（再）保险洞察：香港/新加坡/日本/中国/印度等 11 个市场 + 按险种与主题
e.summary_en: Asia (re)insurance insight organised by market: 11 markets including Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan, China and India, plus by line and topic
e.summary_hk: 按市場切分的亞洲（再）保險洞察：香港/新加坡/日本/中國/印度等 11 個市場 + 按險種與主題
e.body: InsuranceAsia News（`insuranceasianews.com`，自我定位「Insights on Asia’s Insurance Market」）是**面向亚洲（再）保险市场的行业洞察平台**，其最有价值的特征是**双维度索引**：**Markets** 维度覆盖 **Hong Kong / Singapore / Australia / Japan / China / India / South Korea / Taiwan / Malaysia / New Zealand**（共 11 个市场），**Business Line** 维度覆盖 Property / Casualty / Marine / Cyber / Energy / **Financial Lines** / **W&I（保证与 indemnity）** / **Parametrics（参数化）**，Topic 维度覆盖 Claims / Catastrophe / M&A / Regulatory / ESG / Renewals / **MGA** / Climate；Content Type 则区分 Analysis / Spotlight / Analytics / **Opinion** / Exclusives；Segments 覆盖 Brokers / Insurers / Reinsurers / **Loss Adjusters** / **Lloyd’s**，另有 Podcasts、Reports、Videos、Conferences、Awards 与 Print Edition。对 RIAA：**「按市场 + 按险种」切分**正是做区域市场研究时最需要的组织方式——尤其 **Hong Kong 单列**、**Lloyd’s 与 Loss Adjusters 单列**、以及 **Parametrics（参数化保险）与 Financial Lines 单列**，说明其编辑口径贴近专业再保与特殊险种市场；与 [[asia-insurance-review]]（更广的亚洲行业刊物）、[[artemis]]（ILS/巨灾债券专门）分工互补；市场规模与监管口径仍应回到官方源（[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[vhis-portal]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[japan-fsa-statistics]]、[[taiwan-insurance-bureau]]）；参数化产品设计可接 [[parametric-insurance-demo]]；适合作香港/亚太市场分析、再保与特殊险种方向。
e.body_en: InsuranceAsia News (`insuranceasianews.com`, self-described as "Insights on Asia’s Insurance Market") is **an industry insight platform for the Asian (re)insurance market**, and its most valuable feature is a **two-dimensional index**: the **Markets** dimension covers **Hong Kong / Singapore / Australia / Japan / China / India / South Korea / Taiwan / Malaysia / New Zealand** (11 markets), the **Business Line** dimension covers Property / Casualty / Marine / Cyber / Energy / **Financial Lines** / **W&I** / **Parametrics**, and the Topic dimension covers Claims / Catastrophe / M&A / Regulatory / ESG / Renewals / **MGA** / Climate; Content Type distinguishes Analysis / Spotlight / Analytics / **Opinion** / Exclusives; Segments cover Brokers / Insurers / Reinsurers / **Loss Adjusters** / **Lloyd’s**, alongside Podcasts, Reports, Videos, Conferences, Awards and a print edition. For RIAA: that **"by market + by line" split** is exactly the organisation regional market research needs — particularly with **Hong Kong listed separately**, and **Lloyd’s and loss adjusters** and **Parametrics and Financial Lines** given their own slots, indicating an editorial stance close to the professional reinsurance and specialty market; it divides labour with [[asia-insurance-review]] (a broader Asian trade title) and [[artemis]] (ILS/cat bond specific); market size and regulatory figures should still come from official sources ([[hk-ia-statistics]], [[vhis-portal]], [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[japan-fsa-statistics]], [[taiwan-insurance-bureau]]); parametric product design connects to [[parametric-insurance-demo]]; suits Hong Kong and Asia-Pacific market analysis, reinsurance and specialty lines.
e.body_hk: InsuranceAsia News（`insuranceasianews.com`）是**面向亞洲（再）保險市場的行業洞察平台**，其最有價值的特徵是**雙維度索引**：**Markets** 覆蓋 **Hong Kong / Singapore / Australia / Japan / China / India / South Korea / Taiwan / Malaysia / New Zealand**（11 個市場），**Business Line** 覆蓋 Property / Casualty / Marine / Cyber / Energy / **Financial Lines** / **W&I** / **Parametrics**，Topic 覆蓋 Claims / Catastrophe / M&A / Regulatory / ESG / Renewals / **MGA** / Climate；Content Type 區分 Analysis / Spotlight / Analytics / **Opinion** / Exclusives；Segments 覆蓋 Brokers / Insurers / Reinsurers / **Loss Adjusters** / **Lloyd’s**。對 RIAA：**「按市場 + 按險種」切分**正是做區域市場研究時最需要的組織方式——尤其 **Hong Kong 單列**、**Lloyd’s 與 Loss Adjusters 單列**、**Parametrics 與 Financial Lines 單列**；與 [[asia-insurance-review]]、[[artemis]] 分工互補；市場規模與監管口徑仍應回到官方源（[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[japan-fsa-statistics]]、[[taiwan-insurance-bureau]]）；參數化產品設計可接 [[parametric-insurance-demo]]；適合作香港/亞太市場分析、再保與特殊險種方向。
